title: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in…
description: Lightdash versions prior to 3.212.0 have a vulnerability in the getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess function that exposes the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. This occurs because project developers can configure the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server, allowing the attacker to capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository. The captured token grants access to all reachable repositories within the organization.
